$comment: Single source of truth for the versions every mfe-pot app repo must stay aligned on. See CLAUDE.md's 'Strong contracts' section: Native Federation's shared-singleton contract (see @tn4consulting/shared-federation-config) requires every app to run the same Angular/RxJS/GCDS version, or the singleton sharing silently breaks at runtime with no compile-time warning across repos. A future version-alignment check reads each deployed remote's live remoteEntry.json (which lists every shared package's exact resolved version) and each BFF's /health, and asserts they all agree with this file.
$sharedFederationRuntimeComment: Now a Native Federation shared singleton too (added to @tn4consulting/shared-federation-config's sharedFederationDependencies) -- its whole purpose is DI-token identity crossing a federation boundary (PAYMENT_HISTORY_WIDGET_LOADER, REACT_MOUNTER, etc.), which requires every consuming app to resolve the exact same package instance. shell and dashboard (the shell-mediated widget-loader loop for job-bank's/employment-insurance's dashboard widgets) must both depend on this version and on the matching shared-federation-config version below -- 0.x caret ranges don't auto-pick-up a minor bump, each app's package.json pin has to move explicitly. employment-life-events isn't required to move in lockstep (it doesn't consume either new widget token), but should before its own PAYMENT_HISTORY_WIDGET_LOADER usage can rely on the same singleton guarantee.
$reactComment: react/reactDom apply only to repos that bundle a React remote via @tn4consulting/shared-federation-config/react -- currently mfe-pot-shell (the mount adapter) and mfe-pot-job-bank (the remote itself). Not applicable to the 3 pure-Angular remotes.
